Reset starts inactive; SHOOT activates after resetting cooldown to randomized cooldown plus charge duration. The flag clears at remaining cooldown <=80frames, independently of rush/recovery mode and target availability.
Low randomized cooldown can end defense during rush; high cooldown can retain defense into recovery. State survives faction-world transfer, while missing/dead source bodies never expose it.
Existing ordinary charge rules have no defense field and never activate this flag.
